text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The wildly popular Umamusume model Gold City has announced her intention to run in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Juggling both career paths leaves her with an intense schedule, but despite her workload, she remains passionately dedicated to her training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her motive—to make everyone see that she's not just some pretty doll.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to show the world her "true self," we begin our daily efforts to prove her skill.
